summary: This bill ensures that federal firefighters continue to receive pay and allowances during government shutdowns and prohibits their removal from service due to reductions in force during such periods by appropriating necessary funds for fiscal year 2026.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly appropriates funds for federal firefighters during a lapse in appropriations, ensuring their pay and allowances. This represents an increase in government spending by guaranteeing these payments even when other appropriations are not in effect.

By appropriating funds to ensure federal firefighter pay during government shutdowns, the bill could contribute to deficit spending if these funds are not offset elsewhere, thus potentially increasing the national debt.
